accepted.text: MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 3 March 2026 between:
Northwind Traders Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales with company number 01234567, whose registered office is at 1 Harbour Street, London E14 5AB ("Northwind"); and
Contoso Pharmaceuticals S.L., a company incorporated in Spain with tax number B12345678, whose registered office is at Calle Mayor 10, 28013 Madrid ("Contoso"),
each a "Party" and together the "Parties".
DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
In this Agreement the following definitions apply:

"Confidential Information" means all information of a confidential nature disclosed by a Party to the other Party, whether in writing, orally or by any other means, including the information described in clause 2.2;
"Purpose" means the evaluation of a possible supply and distribution arrangement between the Parties;
"Representatives" means a Party's employees, officers, professional advisers and contractors who need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose.
Clause headings do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement. Words in the singular include the plural and vice versa.
OBLIGATIONS OF CONFIDENTIALITY
Each Party shall keep the other Party's Confidential Information confidential and shall not use it except for the Purpose.
Confidential Information includes, without limitation:
technical data, formulae, specifications and know-how;
commercial information, including pricing, customers and suppliers; and
the existence and terms of the discussions between the Parties.
The obligations in this clause do not apply to information that:
is or becomes generally available to the public other than through a breach of this Agreement;
was lawfully in the possession of the receiving Party before disclosure; or
is required to be disclosed by law, provided that the receiving Party:
gives the disclosing Party prompt written notice; and
discloses only the minimum information required.
TERM AND RETURN OF INFORMATION

This Agreement continues for a period of three (3) years from its date. On request, each Party shall return or destroy the other Party's Confidential Information, subject to the exceptions in clause 2.3.
GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement and any dispute arising out of it are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Signed by the Parties on the date stated above.
For and on behalf of Northwind Traders Limited
For and on behalf of Contoso Pharmaceuticals S.L.
